thread:
rhea_cs: Quick sync — onboarding for SilverBridge shows rising p95 on text-gen during their peak batch jobs. They're worried about trial churn. Any low-friction mitigations we can propose? :wave:

noah_sre: thx for the ping. Can you share model + streaming mode + typical prompt sizes? Also are these batched/parallel calls?

rhea_cs: model=redwood-1-standard-v2, streaming=false, avg prompt 110 tokens, spikes come from scheduled bulk summarization (concurrency ~30). Sample (sanitized):

```json
{"model":"redwood-1-standard-v2","input":"Condense report into bullets","max_tokens":220}
```

anya_ml: For bulk jobs we usually recommend: 1) try redwood-1-compact-int8-v3 as a cheaper lane for non-interactive batches 2) enable request-level batching with batch_size=24 3) add prefix caching for repeated templates. Quality drop was ~1% on similar corpora.

claire_se: Ops suggestion: do a 72h canary at 20% traffic routed to compact-int8-v3 for scheduled jobs only. Also set concurrency caps on the compact pool (max_concurrency=40) and enable autoscale buffer. We'll also throttle job start windows to smooth spikes.

rhea_cs: can we get a pasteable canary + routing snippet? I'll send to customer with success criteria: p95 < 400ms, throughput uplift, quality regression <=2%.

noah_sre: snippet to paste:

```yaml
canary_id: sb-4876543210
duration_hours: 72
traffic_rules:
  - selector: schedule == "bulk-summary"
    model: redwood-1-compact-int8-v3
    percent: 20
  - selector: default
    model: redwood-1-standard-v2
    percent: 80
batching:
  enabled: true
  batch_size: 24
concurrency:
  compact_pool_max: 40
quant:
  profile: int8-balanced
rollback:
  - metric: semantic_similarity_drop
    threshold: 0.02
    comparator: gt
metrics: [p95_latency, tokens_per_request, semantic_similarity]
```

anya_ml: I'll run an automated eval on their sample corpora and surface paragraph-level diffs. If we see topic-specific regressions, we can try int8-fast or fall back to standard for those topics.

rhea_cs: I'll message SilverBridge with the plan and ask for a representative batch. Can we schedule a 24h check-in?

deploy-bot: Canary deployed: sb-4876543210. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/sb-4876543210

noah_sre: I'll enable alerting: if hallucination_rate > 0.03 or p95 increases >20% vs baseline then auto-notify and auto-fallback.

rhea_cs: awesome — thanks team. Will follow up after first 24h snapshot. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
